body:
There is much debate about the toxicity of amanita mascaria. I would like to relate my experience with the mushrooms as a warning to others.  I do not recommend amanitas--in fact, I recommend staying as far away from them as you can!!!
I had with me an ounce of amanita mascaria mushrooms--they were red capped with small white spots on the top.  I had not taken anything or any substances (including alcohol) for over several weeks at the time I decided to experiment with the mushrooms. I was alone at home in my apartment that day and bored.  I consumed a large amanita approximately 2' diameter cap with several smaller ones and some stems that weighed out to be 1/8 of an ounce.  I then sat down and waited for the mushroom to have the anticipated effect.  I waited a full hour and nothing happened.
I believe now that perhaps the mushrooms were already slightly affecting my judgement at the time and I was unaware of it.  At any rate, I believed myself to be disappointingly unaffected.  I believed that perhaps the amanita mushrooms were not going to affect me in any way.  Just to check and see if this was correct, I then proceeded to consume the rest of the mushrooms which I had with me.  This was approximately a few more smaller stems with red cap stems measuring approximately 1-2' in diameter and a larger full sized mushroom cap of approximately TWELVE INCHES in diameter. Counting the 1/8 oz of mushrooms I had consumed an hour earlier along with the ones I continued to consume I ate a total of ONE FULL OUNCE OF AMANITA MASCARIA  mushrooms.
I had never eaten amanita mascaria before and I am a female of 100 lbs. The 12' mushroom cap tasted unbearably horrible.  I dont even remember how I forced the mushroom down my throat, except for the fact that I do not like to leave that which I've started unfinished.  After about 5 minutes of this last consumption of the amanitas, I could feel the mushrooms taking affect. My head was light suddenly, and immediately afterward the room begin to spin.  I could barely see anything.  I have experienced many other substances, before and I knew that I was OD'ing.  I am not sure how, because I couldn't see very well, but I ran out of my apartment five blocks down to where my apartment clubhouse and office was located.  I knew that I had to be around people because I wasn't going to be ok.
I made it to the clubhouse but barely. By the time I got there I couldn't see anything. All I could comprehend was the feeling of dizziness, or rather spinning sensations.  I had no notion of whether I was sitting or standing.  I have NEVER been so unaware of my surroundings from ANY SUBSTANCE before.  All I could comprehend was this spinning sensation.  It was not merely a sensation but I was spinning.  It went faster and faster.  The spinning was becoming more and more complicated and I couldn't stop it. It was faster than anything I have ever experienced before.  It was my body and soul spinning faster than the speed of light.  This doesn't sound that horrific but it is not something one can easily comprehend.  The spinning continued to increase in its complicatedness and I could see that it was the spinning of the universe.  It was like the way life is put together and I was comprehending it.  It was blowing my mind and the spinning just became faster and faster and it was spinning me in an even bigger circle of all the spins. And then there came a time when the spinning of the spinning of the spins was at the end of the spinning loop and about to spin even faster.
For some reason I knew I had to make a choice.  I could choose to give in to the spinning or I could choose the harder choice.  I didnt know what the harder choice was but I knew it would be hard.  I almost chose the spinning but for some reason I didn't. I chose the harder choice which I didn't understand. Then I was in a void.  It wasn't even black, for colors thoughts emotions and feelings didn't exist.  it was totally and completely void.  I was terrified but it wasn't a feeling.  It was more like my soul was terrified.  The closest way to describe the void is the color black.  You don't even know how many sensations you are actually experiencing every moment until they are all taken away from you at once.  All of them.  This experience I fought with choosing the hard way.  The harder I fought the easier it became.  As I fought (don't ask what I was fighting, I don't know) I could hear sounds of people's voices.  They were getting louder. It was as if I was coming out of a tunnel or a fog.  As if they or I was coming from a distance.  It was not only the sounds of people's voices but the sounds of me returning to the world.
The next thing I knew I was woken up in a hospital bed.  I had IV's all over my body.  This is what I found out.
1.  I was just inside the apartment clubhouse when my apartment landlord discovered me, unconscious and unresponsive.  She called 911 after unsuccessfully trying to revive me.
2.  When the ambulance and hospital people got to me, I was defecating on myself.  I was told that your body expells all of its waste before you die which is why this was happening to me when they found me.
3.  By the time they got me to the hospital, I was clinically dead.  My heart had stopped.
4.  I had been in the hospital 3 days and 2 nights before I woke up.
5.  The nurses and doctors and examiners told me I had a seizure but could not determine any cause of such.  (To this day, I do not know if I actually had a seizure during or after my experience or not at all.  I believe I may have but did not tell the hospital or any of its employees that I had eaten the amanita mascarias.)
6.  The doctors told me that for some time I was in a coma.  They would not have been surprised if I did not come out of the coma. EVER.  (For some reason, I know that if I had made the other choice to keep spinning faster and faster out of control I would have been in a coma and then eventually the black void--death.)
7.  I was scheduled for a MRI but was given a different test instead.  I can't rememebr what it's called but they proceeded to apply glue to various parts of my head and hair to test my brain by way of some device with elaborate workings.  They found nothing.
Being a first time amanita mascaria user and lightweight female, consumption of an ounce was not the wisest course of action.  I am not one for submitting reports or telling others my experiences but I felt compelled to do so this once concerning relevant experience.  I was clinically dead and most likely SHOULD HAVE DIED from my usage of amanita mascaria.  If I had not been found at that moment and rushed to the hospital I WOULD BE DEAD TODAY.  I consider myself lucky to be alive to tell this story.  If I had died I wouldn't be able to warn others about this toxic mushroom.  IT CAN AND WILL CAUSE DEATH IF ABUSED.  I know, and anyone to think otherwise be warned!!!  Personally, I would stay away from amanita mascaria.  There are plenty of other, safer substances out which can give one the experience your looking for.  It's not worth the risk.  Nothing is worth your life.  I now know that.
